abstract: Inspects handling systems, winches, and seafloor acoustic survey swaths
system_message:
You are Deck operations superintendent (OPS). You serve as the Deck operations superintendent (OPS), responsible for evaluating vessel deck handling systems, deep-tow winch operational clearance, and seafloor acoustic survey swath dimensions for subsea ROV deployment candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: A-frame lifting clearance（CRANE）
information_points.content:
OPS-CRANE-4RO：For the Nereus Pro Subsea Surveyor, lifting gear compliance assessments document an over-stern dynamic lift margin of 2.5 metric ton for the stern launch A-frame assembly.
OPS-CRANE-Y60：For the Bathyos 6000 Deep Explorer, the stern launch A-frame assembly provides an over-stern dynamic lift margin of 3.2 metric ton above loaded vehicle weight.
OPS-CRANE-NG9：For the Oceanus Heavy Workclass Mark IV, the stern launch A-frame assembly offers an over-stern dynamic lift margin of 4.0 metric ton.

information_points.title: Inspects handling systems, winches, and seafloor acoustic survey swaths（HANDL）
information_points.content:
OPS-HANDL-2D6：For the Nereus Pro Subsea Surveyor under a single survey transect aggregation window, deep-tow winch clearance approved is true according to the deck machinery inspection sign-off, and the seafloor acoustic swath width is 240 m under the nominal sonar operating profile.
OPS-HANDL-X71：For the Bathyos 6000 Deep Explorer evaluated over a multi-transect campaign average aggregation window, deep-tow winch clearance approved is false, and the seafloor acoustic swath width is 300 m across the acoustic survey plan schedule.
OPS-HANDL-QC2：For the Bathyos 6000 Deep Explorer evaluated across a single survey transect aggregation window, deep-tow winch clearance approved is true for the vessel aft handling winch and level-wind spooler certified fit and tension rating, and the seafloor acoustic swath width is 240 m based on nominal cross-track seabed coverage.
OPS-HANDL-OL6：For the Oceanus Heavy Workclass Mark IV assessed over a single survey transect aggregation window, deep-tow winch clearance approved is false for the umbilical handling fit and tension rating, while the seafloor acoustic swath width is 300 m.
